levels.surface: أحمد بن عبد الله بن الحكم
أحمد بن عبد الله بن الحكم

notes: Abu al-Minhal asks two men, each answers «سل» the other: both are links, one per route (rule 5: the one asked who answers is a link); the routes are written in full because the names differ after أبا المنهال
«فقالا جميعا نهى رسول الله» is one saying told by both Companions: the Prophet is not a link
«زيدا» is the accusative of the name as the text writes it at that place; «سل زيد بن أرقم» is an answer, not the link
